peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 4.9% below its local comparables; 30 of 85 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (46.1): 2.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 118 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 9). Context, not scored: resales in 66.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $1,510,000 ($1,199 psf, 850–1,506 sq ft; 5 resales, Aug 2025–Jul 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,261 psf (range $1,161–1,332); 4.9% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $78,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Tampines East MRT about 920 m, Upper Changi MRT about 2,040 m; closer than 60 of 462 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest White Sands Primary School about 650 m; more than 242 of 462 similar developments (the same as 97). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 390 m), more than 288 of 462 similar developments (the same as 94); nearest hawker centre Pasir Ris Central Hawker Centre about 1,960 m; nearest park Tampines Eco Green Park about 1,290 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming on the Cross Island Line: Pasir Ris East MRT about 610 m (LTA target 2030) and Loyang MRT about 1,320 m (LTA target 2030), both under construction. Straight-line distances to the planned station sites; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Kassia, 22 new sales, about 430 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 31 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 653 new sales and 492 resales (1,145 purchases); new sales were 57% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 492 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 81 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 492 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 553 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−11%). Planning-area private resales −4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
